name.en: Verify a retrieved UI recommendation before reuse
name.zh: 复用前验证检索到的界面建议

candidate_additions.reason: Distinct local retrieval contract: route to the smallest mode, verify result applicability, retry once, and never persist unverified/fabricated output. This is neither an external learning-resource catalog recommendation nor a host-level meta-router.

en.description: Treat a retrieved UI suggestion as provisional until its scope and identity fit the request.
en.scenario: A UI task could use a stack rule, style reference, or general UX guideline, and its first result may be stale or irrelevant.
en.mechanism: Choose the smallest applicable search mode, express one intent with two to five terms, then verify the result's domain/category and top item's identity and applicability. Retry once when needed, label any fallback, and do not persist unverified output.
en.bad: Hypothetical fixture: for ‘React confirmation dialog traps keyboard focus’, searching every catalog returns an unrelated pricing-palette hit; accepting it because it mentions React preserves the wrong style recommendation.
en.good: Hypothetical fixture: search the UX mode for ‘dialog keyboard focus’, verify the result’s category, item, and platform fit, then search the known stack separately only if needed; if no suitable match appears, label the fallback and do not invent guidance.
en.why: A concise query can still retrieve the wrong domain; checking both category and item fit catches that error before it becomes durable guidance.
en.expected: The selected mode, query, top result, retry/fallback, and persistence decision can be inspected.
en.boundaries: This does not validate catalog accuracy or guarantee design quality. A failed search is not permission to invent a result; human review may still be needed. The two-to-five-term query and one-retry limit are bounded source-policy examples, not validated universal optima; choose terms and retry behavior by task, catalog, and freshness.

zh.description: 检索到的界面建议在范围与身份符合请求前都只是候选内容。
zh.scenario: 一项界面任务可能需要技术栈规则、风格参考或通用UX指南，而首条结果可能过时或不相关。
zh.mechanism: 选择最小适用搜索模式，用2至5个词表达一个意图；随后核对结果的领域/类别以及首条内容的身份和适用性。必要时只重试一次，标明回退结果，并且不保存未经核验的输出。
zh.bad: 假设示例：针对“React 确认对话框困住键盘焦点”，遍搜所有目录后命中无关的定价页配色；仅因它提到 React 就接受，会把错误的风格建议保留下来。
zh.good: 假设示例：先在 UX 模式搜索“对话框 键盘 焦点”，核对结果类别、条目与平台是否适用；只有确实需要时才单独搜索已知技术栈。若没有合适结果，就如实标注回退项，不编造指南。
zh.why: 简短查询仍可能命中错误领域；同时核对类别与条目适用性，可在错误变成持久指南前发现问题。
zh.expected: 可以检查所选模式、查询词、首条结果、重试/回退和保存决策。
zh.boundaries: 此契约不验证目录事实准确性，也不保证设计质量。搜索失败不代表可以编造结果；仍可能需要人工复核。 2至5个查询词与只重试一次是该来源给出的有界策略示例，不是经验证的普遍最优值；应结合任务、目录内容与新鲜度判断其适用性。

sources.section: Select smallest search mode and verify query/result fit

candidate_update_suggestions.recommendation: Enrich with runtime contract: resolve installed helpers from the skill base but project token artifacts from project cwd; inspect existing sources, constrain force to managed generated files, then verify.
Enrich with primitive→semantic→component layers, CSS/Tailwind source ownership, state/variant matrices, and no silent parallel source of truth.

Add provisional-gate boundary: 90 relevance cases split calibration/held-out, 16 locked; independent second human judgment still required. Saved baseline met recorded floors on static recomputation, but evaluator was not run here.
Cross-reference held-out/locked-case gate while preserving provisional status; no fresh test pass claim.
Use stored baseline only as frozen regression comparison; retain sample/metric floors and prohibit tuning on held-out examples.
Enrich with live-browser findings versus heuristic scanner evidence; static output is not browser validation. No browser/scanner was run here.
Add source revision and freshness boundary: saved catalog/provenance checks validate a snapshot, not current external data.
Enrich configuration persistence with Master defaults/page overrides, inspect-before-write, ownership-aware force only for managed generated token files, and post-write verification.
Keep preset catalog vs generate-on-the-fly fallback/preview distinct from query-fit: one selects/creates a design artifact, the other verifies retrieved result applicability.
Keep schema-validator gates as support, not retrieval-fit: structural validation does not establish semantic applicability before persistence.
Keep existing banner text-free visual layer/editable HTML copy candidate; do not add a second copy mechanism.
Keep existing honest capture-gap result candidate; no extra reporting mechanism is proposed.

partition_reconciliation.merge_rule: Join by repo/path/hash; apply only to rows still pending at the assigned frozen commit. Preserve existing non-pending outcomes and all other repositories/candidates.

execution: Frozen source read-only. No source skill/script/test/provider/deployment execution; no upstream or shared-harvest writes.

evidence_repair.binary_hash_note: For binary records, the coverage hash is SHA-256 of raw bytes; no LF normalization is applied.
evidence_repair.candidate_example: Project-authored hypothetical React confirmation-dialog keyboard-focus fixture; no actual search output is asserted.
evidence_repair.prior_claim: Previous whole-file labels could not substantiate actual body reading; they were withdrawn and replaced with fresh per-file semantic reads. Mirror rows claim verified equivalence, not occurrence reading.
